maria: Heads up — onboarding HF model `gpt-mini-2` hit tokenization failures in CI. tokenizer.json and tokenizer_config.json disagree on `special_tokens` (pad/sep/chat_start). full error: `ValueError: unknown special token '<|chat_start|>'`

token-bot: CI run: https://ci.internal/redwood/models/3421/logs (job 3421) — token mismatch detected, failing unit: tokenization/consistency_test

alex: Can you paste the two files? often this is a conversion script bug where tokenizer.json was regenerated but tokenizer_config.json left stale.

maria: snippets: 
```
# tokenizer_config.json
{ "bos_token": "<|bos|>", "eos_token": "<|eos|>", "additional_special_tokens": ["<|sep|>"] }
```
```
# tokenizer.json (fast)
... contains "special_tokens_map": {"chat_start": "<|chat_start|>", "sep": "<|sep|>"} ...
```

jia: That explains the eval regression we saw after quantization tests — model was tokenizing chat prompts with slow tokenizer fallback, losing <|chat_start|> so several prompt prefixes trimmed. Dev-evals: ~3.2% drop on instruct summarization.

samir: Quick workaround: force slow tokenizer to include missing specials until we regenerate tokenizer.json. Command we used elsewhere: 
```
python - <<EOF
from transformers import PreTrainedTokenizerFast, AutoTokenizer
t = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('local_gpt_mini2', use_fast=False)
for tok in ['<|chat_start|>','<|chat_end|>']:
    if tok not in t.special_tokens_map.values():
        t.add_special_tokens({'additional_special_tokens':[tok]})
    t.save_pretrained('local_gpt_mini2_fixed')
EOF
```

alex: Long term we should add a CI check: if tokenizer.json exists, assert serialized special tokens parity with tokenizer_config.json and with HF `tokenizer.json`->`tokenizer_config.json` mapping script. Could add in model-registry validation step.

maria: I'll run regen script on the artifact and open a PR to model-registry with a fix and a unit test. tentative plan: 1) regen tokenizer.json from tokenizer_config using tokenizers lib 2) run token parity check 3) run dev-evals subset. I'll assign myself.

token-bot: Created issue #MM-789: "special-tokens parity check + regen for gpt-mini-2" — linked CI, tagging @maria.

maria: Thanks. If anyone sees weird tokenization locally, run the slow-tokenizer patch above and ping me. Will update thread when PR is up. :thumbsup:
